government.note: Parliamentary grand duchy. Governments are coalitions formed after elections to the unicameral Chamber of Deputies; the Grand Duke's role is largely ceremonial. Since the Second World War every Prime Minister has been from the CSV except Gaston Thorn (DP, 1974-1979) and Xavier Bettel (DP, 2013-2023). National referendums were held in 2005 (European Constitution) and 2015 (three constitutional questions).

holders.note: Abdicated in favour of his son Henri, who had acted for him as regent since 4 March 1998.
Abdicated in favour of his son Guillaume, who had been regent since 8 October 2024.

offices.note: Heirs are the line of succession on 2000-01-01: Hereditary Grand Duke Henri, then his eldest son Guillaume. Since Guillaume's accession on 3 October 2025 the heir apparent is his son Prince Charles (born 2020), who is not recorded as a person because the schema accepts birth years only up to 2010. Succession was changed to absolute primogeniture in June 2011.

system.note: Proportional representation in four multi-member constituencies (North 9, East 7, South 23, Centre 21). Voters may vote for a list or cast as many candidate votes as there are seats (panachage). Seats are allocated by the Hagenbach-Bischoff quota. Voting is compulsory for resident citizens under 75. seats_2000 is the result of the 13 June 1999 election.
